title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
desc: 福格先生打賭能在八十天內環遊世界，搭火車、汽船，甚至騎大象和時間賽跑。

intro: I'm reading 'Around the World in Eighty Days' by Jules Verne. Phileas Fogg bets he can travel around the world in just 80 days!
我在讀凡爾納的《環遊世界八十天》。福格先生打賭他能在八十天內環遊世界！

q: Fogg uses trains, steamships, and even an elephant. Which way of traveling sounds the most exciting to you?
福格搭火車、汽船，甚至騎大象。哪種旅行方式你覺得最刺激？
o: The elephant, definitely!
當然是大象！
definitely = 絕對、當然，用來加強語氣。
Same here! In India, they ride an elephant through the jungle because the railway isn't finished.
我也是！在印度，因為鐵路還沒蓋完，他們騎大象穿越叢林。
Steamships. I love the ocean.
汽船。我愛海洋。
steamship = 蒸汽船。
Ocean journeys were slow back then, but so romantic.
那時候的海上旅程很慢，但很浪漫。
Honestly, I'd rather fly.
老實說，我寧願搭飛機。
honestly = 老實說。I'd rather = 我寧願。
Ha! There were no planes in 1872. That's why it took 80 days!
哈！1872年還沒有飛機。所以才要八十天！

q: Fogg follows a very strict schedule. When you travel, do you plan everything or just go?
福格嚴格按照時間表行動。你旅行時會規劃好一切，還是說走就走？
o: I plan every detail in advance.
我會事先規劃每個細節。
in advance = 事先。detail = 細節。
You're just like Fogg! He knows every train timetable by heart.
你就像福格！他把每張火車時刻表都背起來了。
I book a hotel and decide the rest later.
我會先訂飯店，其他的之後再決定。
book 當動詞 = 預訂。the rest = 剩下的部分。
That's a smart balance. A place to sleep is the most important thing.
這是聰明的平衡。有地方睡最重要。
I just go with the flow.
我就隨遇而安。
go with the flow = 順其自然，常用片語。
Passepartout, his servant, would love traveling with you!
他的僕人路路通會很愛跟你一起旅行！

q: In the story, a train stops because a bridge is broken. Have you ever had a delay while traveling?
故事中，火車因為橋壞了而停下。你旅行時遇過延誤嗎？
o: Yes, my flight was delayed for five hours.
有，我的班機延誤了五小時。
be delayed = 被延誤。flight = 班機。
Five hours! That's painful. Fogg would be so nervous.
五小時！好痛苦。福格一定很緊張。
I once missed my train.
我曾經錯過火車。
once = 曾經。miss = 錯過。
Oh no! Fogg always carries extra money for new tickets in moments like that.
糟糕！福格總是帶著額外的錢，在那種時候買新票。
Not really. I'm lucky.
沒有耶。我很幸運。
Not really = 不太有，比直接說 No 柔和。
Lucky you! Fogg is not so lucky. Everything goes wrong for him.
你真幸運！福格就沒那麼幸運，什麼都不順。

q: At the end, Fogg thinks he's one day late, but he forgot about time zones! Have you ever had jet lag?
結局福格以為晚了一天，但他忘了時區！你有過時差嗎？
o: Yes, I couldn't sleep for days.
有，我好幾天睡不著。
couldn't = 無法（過去式）。for days = 好幾天。
Jet lag is the worst. I drink lots of water when I arrive.
時差最糟了。我抵達時會喝很多水。
No, I've never flown that far.
沒有，我沒飛過那麼遠。
have never flown = 從未飛過（現在完成式）。
Someday you will! Then you'll understand Fogg's confusion.
總有一天會的！到時你就懂福格的困惑了。
That ending is so clever!
那個結局太聰明了！
不直接回答，而是評論故事，也是很好的回應。
Right? Traveling east, he gained a whole day without knowing it.
對吧？一路往東走，他在不知不覺中多賺了一整天。

end: What a trip! Next time, let's talk about packing for it.
好一趟旅程！下次來聊聊怎麼打包吧。

intro: Let's talk about packing! Fogg leaves London with just one small bag.
我們來聊打包！福格只帶一個小袋子就離開倫敦。

q: Fogg packs only two shirts and three pairs of socks. How many clothes do you pack for a trip?
福格只帶兩件襯衫和三雙襪子。你旅行帶多少衣服？
o: Way too many. My suitcase is always full.
太多了。我的行李箱總是滿的。
way too many = 多太多了，way 用來加強語氣。suitcase = 行李箱。
Ha! Me too. I always pack clothes I never wear.
哈！我也是。我總是帶一些根本不會穿的衣服。
Just enough for each day.
剛好每天夠穿。
just enough = 剛剛好。
Very organized! Fogg would approve.
很有條理！福格會認同的。
I pack light and buy things there.
我輕裝出發，到當地再買。
pack light = 輕裝打包。
That's exactly Fogg's plan! He buys what he needs on the way.
這正是福格的計畫！他路上需要什麼就買什麼。

q: He travels through hot India and snowy America. What do you wear in really cold weather?
他穿越炎熱的印度和下雪的美國。你在很冷的天氣穿什麼？
o: A thick down jacket and a scarf.
厚羽絨外套和圍巾。
down jacket = 羽絨外套。scarf = 圍巾。
Smart. In the story, they cross the snowy plains of America.
聰明。故事中他們穿越美國的雪原。
Layers. A sweater under my coat.
洋蔥式穿法。外套裡面穿毛衣。
layers = 多層穿搭。sweater = 毛衣。
Layers are the best. You can take one off when it gets warm.
多層穿最好了，變熱時可以脫掉一件。
Gloves! My hands get cold easily.
手套！我的手很容易冷。
gloves = 手套（通常用複數）。easily = 容易地。
Mine too. Cold hands make everything harder.
我也是。手冷做什麼都比較難。

q: In hot places, people in the book wear light cotton clothes. What fabric do you like in summer?
在炎熱的地方，書中的人穿輕薄的棉質衣服。你夏天喜歡什麼材質？
o: Cotton. It's soft and cool.
棉。柔軟又涼爽。
cotton = 棉。
Cotton is classic. Easy to wash, too.
棉是經典。也很好洗。
Linen, even though it wrinkles.
亞麻，雖然它容易皺。
linen = 亞麻。even though = 雖然。wrinkle = 起皺。
Linen looks so elegant. The wrinkles are part of the style!
亞麻看起來很優雅。皺褶也是風格的一部分！
Sportswear that dries quickly.
快乾的運動服。
sportswear = 運動服。dry quickly = 乾得快。
Very practical, especially if you sweat a lot.
很實用，尤其是如果你很會流汗。

q: Passepartout loses his shoes at one point and has to run barefoot! What's the one item you never travel without?
路路通有一次弄丟鞋子，只好光著腳跑！你旅行時一定會帶的一樣東西是什麼？
o: Comfortable walking shoes.
好走的鞋。
comfortable = 舒適的。
Very wise, after hearing about poor Passepartout!
聽完可憐的路路通的故事，這很明智！
My phone charger.
我的手機充電器。
charger = 充電器。
Of course! Today, Fogg would carry a power bank.
當然！換成今天，福格一定會帶行動電源。
My passport, of course.
當然是我的護照。
passport = 護照。of course = 當然。
The most important one! Without it, no trip at all.
最重要的一樣！沒有它就完全出不了門。

end: Great chat! Maybe I'll pack lighter next time, like Fogg.
聊得很開心！也許我下次會像福格一樣輕裝打包。
